description: XPBD drop with tet volume constraints (Stage X2): same block, drop and edge material as drop_xpbd.json, plus volume compliance 1e-6 1/Pa (as stiff as a 1e6 Pa penalty, 10x the mass-spring kv). Stable from 22 substeps; 50 keeps the worst volume error under the proposal's 1% (0.90%). Mass-spring needs ~400 substeps for this volume stiffness.
